mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 0.3 percentage points signals stronger employment momentum, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) or IC drops below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 5% signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and pressures cyclicals, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) or IC drops below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -0.5% signals manufacturing weakness, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and drags on the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) or IC drops below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) or IC drops below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in Real Personal Income exceeding 1% signals reduced consumer purchasing power, which lowers demand for equities and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) or IC drops below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in the unemployment rate above 0.4 percentage points signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and drags on equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the trigger is met (t-test p > 0.05) or IC drops below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in GDP growth below 1% alongside a 2-month decline in Housing Starts exceeding 5% signals broad demand weakness, which reduces earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > 1% in 3 months AND HOUST falls > 5% in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both triggers are met (t-test p > 0.05) or IC drops below 0.01.
